
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/luoht/p/20176232" title="发布于 2026-05-26 20:53">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于ONNXRuntime C#实现的高性能YOLO推理框架</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><a href="https://github.com/meloht/YoloSharpOnnx" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">YoloSharpOnnx</a>是一个高性能、内存复用、跨平台的 C# YOLO 推理库，基于 OpenCV 和 ONNX 运行时实现。</p>
<h1>背景</h1>
<p>刚开始做工业检测项目时，在网上找了一些现成的YOLO推理库，发现都不怎么好用，性能也一般，并且部署不是很方便，只支持少数几种硬件部署，另外项目需要使用批量检测的功能，网上的一些YOLO推理框架都没有批量推理的功能，于是干脆就自己动手封装一个YOLO推理框架，方便修改优化，可以随时根据需求调整功能或添加功能。</p>
<p>完成基本的目标检测功能后，后面一个月时间，陆陆续续把YOLO所有的功能都完善了，就把代码放到GitHub上面开源了</p>
<h1>功能特色</h1>
<ul>
<li>支持所有YOLO任务：目标检测、图片分类、实例分割、姿势估计、OBB</li>
<li>支持多种部署方案：CPU, CUDA / TensorRT, OpenVINO, CoreML, DirectML</li>
<li>可以批量检测图片，性能大幅优于单线程串行执行</li>
<li>图像处理使用OpenCVSharp</li>
<li>推理引擎：<a href="https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime" rel="noopener nofollow">ONNX Runtime</a>&nbsp;是一个跨平台的机器学习模型加速器</li>
</ul>

<h1>使用示例</h1>
<h2>1 导出模型为onnx格式</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> ultralytics <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> YOLO

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Load a model</span>
model = YOLO(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path/to/best.pt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Export the model to ONNX format</span>
model.export(format=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">onnx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)</pre>
</div>
<h2>2 YoloSharpOnnx初始化</h2>
<p>安装Nuget 包YoloSharpOnnx, OnnxRuntime, OpenCvSharp4.runtime</p>
<h3 class="heading-element" dir="auto">CPU推理</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet add package YoloSharpOnnx
dotnet add package OpenCvSharp4.runtime.win
dotnet add package Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> YoloSharp yolo = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> YoloSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ExecutionProviderCPU(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yolo11n.onnx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h3 class="heading-element" dir="auto">CoreML推理</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet add package YoloSharpOnnx

dotnet add package Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

</div>

List</span>&lt;DetectionResult&gt; res =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> yolo.RunDetect(image);

yolo.DrawDetections(image,res);
Cv2.ImWrite(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bus_res.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, image);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> printString =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> res.Summary();
Console.WriteLine(printString);</span></pre>
</div>

<h3>批量处理API</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestBatchInfer()
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> modelPath = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">D:\code\model\best.onnx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> dir = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">D:\code\model\TestImages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    DirectoryInfo directory </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DirectoryInfo(dir);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> files =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> directory.GetFiles()
    System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch _stopwatch </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch();
    _stopwatch.Start();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> num=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">files.Length;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (YoloSharp yolo = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> YoloSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ExecutionProviderDirectML(modelPath, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)))
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = yolo.RunBatchDetect(dir,<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ProcessCallback(), ReceiveProcess, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    }
    _stopwatch.Stop()
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">detect {num} images, time:{_stopwatch.Elapsed}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ReceiveProcess(DetectionBatchResult e)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> res =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.Results.Summary();
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ProcessCallback : IBatchProcessCallback
{
   
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ReceiveProcessResult(DetectionBatchResult e)
    {
       
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> res =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.Results.Summary();
      
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>批量处理Foreach API</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task TestBatchForeachInfer()
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> files =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Directory.GetFiles(dir);
    System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch _stopwatch </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch();
    _stopwatch.Start();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> num =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> files.Length;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (YoloSharp yolo = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> YoloSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ExecutionProviderDirectML(modelPath, _deviceId)))
    {
        yolo.YoloConfiguration.BatchPoolSize </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> item <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> yolo.BatchDetectForeachAsync(files.ToList()))
        {
            Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{item.ImagePath} {item.Results.Summary()}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
    }
    _stopwatch.Stop();
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">detect {num} images, time:{_stopwatch.Elapsed}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>

<h3>测试数据</h3>
<p dir="auto">Images:&nbsp;300 images (image size: 2480x3494)</p>
<p dir="auto">Yolo Model:&nbsp;Yolo11n.onnx InputShape float32[1,3,1280,1280]</p>
<p dir="auto">Inference Provider:&nbsp;DirectML Inference Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.DirectML 1.24.3</p>
